verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships the Inso CLI, explicitly documented as designed to run in CI environments with disabled prompts and exit codes, plus lint commands to fail builds on errors, enabling headless automation of collection runs and tests. This directly matches the story of running headlessly in CI. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of Inso CLI reliability in real CI pipelines, and more detail on scripting/extensibility of CLI beyond lint/test/run commands.
